title: 第20章 干尸第21章 母女
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
“才二十三人，这个据点人挺少的啊，可惜了，要是多一点就好了。”
已经换成一袭黑衣，头戴面具的齐源站在院外听着里面的声音。
为了方便掌控外城，海鲸帮在外城建立了许多据点，这里就是其中一个据点。
此时里面的人都已经喝的五迷三道，有的已经趴在桌子上呼呼大睡。
也就是这时，黄粱一梦开始从半空中飘向众人。
“嗯？哪里来的雾气？”一个已经酩酊大醉的人看着眼前的雾气，还没等反应过来，雾气已经从此人的嘴巴跟鼻子涌入。
一瞬间此人就倒在桌子上，陷入梦境当中。
其他人听到声音看了过来，见到这人在桌子上呼吸均匀的睡着了，谁都没当回事。
刚想转头继续喝酒的瞬间，心雾就涌了上来，伴随着碰撞声，众人都纷纷倒下。
齐源这时也从屋顶上跳了下来，看也没看这些人，直接朝着房间内走去。
听他们之前说的话，现在收取的保护费还没上交，那齐源只能勉为其难的替他们保管一下了。
不多时齐源就从房间里面找到了一个上锁的箱子。
不过对于齐源来说，这个锁跟没有一样，抓住锁头直接一掰就掰断了。
打开箱子映入眼帘的就是银票跟底下的银子，大概看了下，应该快有上千两了。
“好家伙，收保护费这么赚钱的吗，随随便便就快上千两了，这还只是一处据点而已。”
感叹了下齐源就盖上了箱子，感知了下他们被吞噬精神的进度。
还不错，放开限制吞噬精神的话，一个普通人没多久就会被吸干了
最开始倒下的一批人精神已经被吞噬干净
就是可惜他们当中没有武者，虽然武者没有专门修炼精神，但是也比普通人要强不少。
就像石修一样，提供的精神比普通人要强得多，进入一次梦境之后也没有感觉到明显的疲惫。

“嗯？有人来了？”
一道脚步声从院落外传进齐源耳朵中，自从这个院落被这群人占据之后，旁边的几户人家都已经搬离了。
而且现在是深夜了，也没有人敢路过这里，怎么突然有人来了？
难道是宋仁？不是！他的脚步声没有这么轻。
来人似乎是专门冲着这里来的，脚步声在院门口就停了下来。
等了一会，似乎是没听到院内的声音，于是推开了院门，此时齐源已经灭了手中的灯，打算看看来人是谁。
等看到了院内陷入睡梦中的众人，来人面色兴奋，眼神中充满了癫狂，像是看到了什么稀世珍宝一样。
不过没有马上上前，而是静静的站在一旁，等了约有一盏茶的时间。
确认院内众人都熟睡了，房间内也没有传来什么动静，就缓步上前。
此时躲在暗处的齐源也看见了这个人，是个身穿破旧衣物的姑娘。
身形消瘦，一米六五左右，看面相也才刚成年不久的样子，脸部有淤青，身上还带着一些泥土。
她诡异的盯着眼前熟睡的众人，眼神中闪过一丝仇恨，但很快就被兴奋、渴望给淹没。
满是伤痕指甲里还带有一些泥土的手，从怀中掏出一个石块，不！准确的说是打磨好的石刀。
拿出石刀，眼神不断的在离她最近的人身上徘徊，最后眼神盯在了这人脖颈处。
随着噗呲一声，石刀直接刺入这人的脖颈，另一只手还捂着这人的嘴巴，似乎是怕这人被疼痛惊醒发出声音。
然而被心雾吞噬精神的人，早就是一副行尸走肉，注定了永远都醒不过来。
不清楚这些的她还以为是她自己做的好，嘴角出现一抹诡异的笑容。
慢慢拔出石刀，一股鲜血喷涌而出，溅到了她的脸上。
没有恐惧，也没有惊慌，而是浑身颤抖，一脸兴奋的看着这一幕，感受着脸上鲜血的温度。
等到鲜血不再喷涌而出，她就把目光盯在了其他人身上。
content_en:
"There are only twenty-three people. There are quite few people in this stronghold. It's a pity. It would be nice if there were more."
Qi Yuan, who had changed into black clothes and a mask, stood outside the hospital and listened to the sounds inside.
In order to control the outer city more easily, the Sea Whale Gang established many strongholds in the outer city, and this is one of them.
At this time, everyone inside was already drunk and some were already lying on the table and fast asleep.
It was at this time that Huang Liang Yimeng began to float towards everyone from mid-air.
"Huh? Where did the fog come from?" A drunk man looked at the fog in front of him. Before he could react, the fog had already poured in from his mouth and nose.
In an instant, the man fell on the table and fell into a dream.
Others heard the sound and looked over. When they saw the man sleeping on the table, breathing evenly, no one took it seriously.
Just when he was about to turn around and continue drinking, the fog in his heart surged up, and with the sound of collision, everyone fell down one after another.
Qi Yuan also jumped down from the roof at this time, without even looking at these people, he walked directly towards the room.
According to what they said before, the protection fee collected has not yet been handed over, so Qi Yuan can only reluctantly keep it for them.
Not long after, Qi Yuan found a locked box from inside the room.
But for Qi Yuan, this lock was like nothing else. He grabbed the head of the lock and broke it directly.
When I opened the box, I saw the banknotes and the silver at the bottom. I took a quick look and found that there should be almost a thousand taels.
"Good guy, do you make money by collecting protection fees? It's almost a thousand taels casually. This is just a stronghold."
Qi Yuan sighed and closed the box, sensing the progress of their spirits being devoured.
Not bad. If you let go of the restrictions and swallow the spirit, an ordinary person will be sucked dry in a short time.
The spirits of the first group of people who fell have been completely devoured.
It's a pity that there are no warriors among them. Although warriors do not specialize in spiritual cultivation, they are still much stronger than ordinary people.
Just like Shi Xiu, the spirit he provided was much stronger than that of ordinary people, and he did not feel any obvious fatigue after entering a dream.
"Huh? Someone is coming?"
The sound of footsteps reached Qi Yuan's ears from outside the courtyard. Since the courtyard was occupied by this group of people, several nearby families have moved out.
And it's late at night, and no one dares to pass by here. Why did someone come suddenly?
Could it be Song Ren? no! His footsteps were not so light.
The visitor seemed to be coming here specifically, as the footsteps stopped at the entrance of the courtyard.
After waiting for a while, it seemed that no sound was heard in the courtyard, so he opened the courtyard door. At this time, Qi Yuan had already extinguished the light in his hand, intending to see who was coming.
When he saw the people in the hospital who were asleep, the visitor looked excited and his eyes were full of madness, as if he had seen some rare treasure.
But he didn't come forward immediately. Instead, he stood aside quietly and waited for about a cup of tea.
After confirming that everyone in the courtyard was asleep and there was no movement from the room, he walked forward slowly.
Qi Yuan, who was hiding in the dark at this time, also saw this person, a girl wearing shabby clothes.
He is thin, about 1.65 meters tall, and looks like he has just reached adulthood. There are bruises on his face and some dirt on his body.
She stared at the sleeping people in front of her strangely, a trace of hatred flashed in her eyes, but was soon overwhelmed by excitement and desire.
The hand, which was full of scars and still had some dirt in its fingernails, took out a stone from his arms, no! To be precise, it is a polished stone knife.
Taking out the stone knife, her eyes kept lingering on the person closest to her, and finally her eyes were fixed on the person's neck.
With a squeaking sound, the stone knife pierced the man's neck directly, and the other hand was still covering the man's mouth, as if he was afraid that the man would be awakened by the pain and make a sound.
However, the spirit is swallowed up by the heart fogThe person has long been a walking zombie, destined to never wake up.
Not knowing this, she thought she had done well on her own, and a strange smile appeared at the corner of her mouth.
Slowly pulling out the stone knife, a stream of blood spurted out and splashed on her face.
There was no fear or panic, but trembling all over, looking at this scene with excitement, feeling the temperature of the blood on his face.
When the blood stopped spurting out, she focused on the others.
